chunks: Ahmad from Ismail ibn Mihran said, 'Abdul Malik ibn Abi al-Harith narrated to us from Jabir from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said,'

The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) delivered this sermon, saying: 'All praise is for Allah. I praise Him, seek His help, seek His forgiveness, seek His guidance, believe in Him, and rely upon Him. And I testify that there is no god except Allah, One, with no partner, and I testify that Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) is His servant and His Messenger, whom He sent with guidance and the true religion, to make it prevail over all other religions, as evidence for Him and a caller to Him.'

So He demolished the pillars of disbelief and illuminated the lanterns of faith. Whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger, the path of true guidance becomes his path and the light of piety becomes his evidence; and whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger misses all true guidance and harms only himself.

I advise you, servants of Allah, with the fear of Allah, as the advice of one who gave sincere counsel and the preaching of one who delivered and strived. Thereafter, indeed Allah, Mighty and Majestic, made Islam an enlightened path, with shining beacons, wherein hearts unite and upon it brothers become brothers. And that which is between us and you from that is constant affection and an ancient covenant, a recognition from each to all of everything upon which we are. May Allah forgive us and you, and peace be upon you, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings.
ai.seo_question: What are the key themes of Amir al-Mu'minin's sermon regarding faith, guidance, and community unity?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this sermon by Imam al-Sadiq (or Ali, depending on the specific chain interpretation in the marriage chapter context) underscores the theological foundation of Islam as a 'luminous path' that unifies hearts and establishes brotherhood. It highlights the practical implication of *Taqwa* (piety) as the mechanism for social cohesion, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the unity of the community under divine guidance and prophetic example.

en.hubeali:
Ahmad, from Ismail Bin Mihran who said, ‘Abdul Malik Bin Abu Al Haris narrated to us, from Jabir, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>

having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> addressed with this sermon, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup>. I<sup>asws</sup> Praise Him<sup>asws</sup>, and seek His<sup>azwj</sup> Support, and seek His<sup>azwj</sup> Forgiveness, and seek His<sup>azwj</sup> Guidance, and believe in Him<sup>azwj</sup>, and rely upon Him<sup>saww</sup>. And I<sup>asws</sup> testify that there is no god except for Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, One, there being no associates for Him<sup>azwj</sup>. And I<sup>asws</sup> testify that Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> is His<sup>azwj</sup> servant and His<sup>azwj</sup> Rasool<sup>saww</sup>, having Sent him<sup>saww</sup> with the Guidance and the True Religion, in order to Make it to prevail over the Religions, all of them, evidencing to Him<sup>azwj</sup>, and calling to Him<sup>azwj</sup>.

So He<sup>azwj</sup> Pulverised the pillars of the disbelief and Illuminated the lanterns of the belief. The one who obeys Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and His<sup>azwj</sup> Rasool<sup>saww</sup>, his way would become the way of true guidance and the light of piety would be his evidence; and the one who disobeys Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and His<sup>azwj</sup> Rasool<sup>saww</sup>, would miss the paths altogether and would never harm anyone except for himself.

I<sup>asws</sup> hereby advise you, servants of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, with the fear of Allah<sup>asws</sup>, being an advice of an adviser, and a preaching of the one who delivers and strives. Thereafter, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Made Al-Islam as the enlightened path wherein are sparkling flags<sup>asws</sup>. The hearts gather therein and upon it the brethren become brothers; and that which is between us<sup>asws</sup> and you from that, is constant cordiality, and an ancient Covenant. Everyone recognises everyone to the entirety of that which we<sup>asws</sup> are upon. May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Forgive us<sup>asws</sup> and you, and the greetings to you all, and Mercy of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and His<sup>azwj</sup> Blessings’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ahmad ibn ‘Isma’il ibn Mehran has said that narrated to us ‘Abd al-Malik ibn abu al-Harith from Jabir who has said the following:

“Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that ’Amir al-Mu’minin, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, once addressed with the following speech: ‘All praise belongs to Allah, I praise Him, beg assistance from Him, ask forgiveness from Him, seek His guidance, believe in Him and place my trust with Him and I testify that no one deserves worship except Allah alone who has no partners and I testify that Muhammad, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, is His servant and His Messenger. He sent him with guidance and true religion to make it dominant over all other religions, as a guide to Him and calling to Him.

So he destroyed the pillars of disbelief and lit up the beacon of belief. Whoever obeys Allah and the Messenger of Allah, the right guidance becomes his path and the light of piety becomes his guide. Whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger misses the straight path altogether and harms no one except himself.

I recommend you, O servants of Allah, to become pious before Allah with an advice from an adviser and a preaching of one who delivers and strives. Thereafter, Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, has made Islam the bright landmarks with shining light houses. In it hearts come together and on its basis are brotherhood and what is between us and you, of such facts are to love Him and old memories among us and everyone knowing everyone else of that on which we are based. May Allah forgive us and you and peace be with you and the blessing of Allah and His kindness.’”
